notes: §1985:VII.3.2.3 SR3: "One or more record description entries must follow the file description entry." BindFileSection calls MaterializeImpliedRecord when an FD binds no level-01 record; below DialectLevel 2002 it reports COBOL1837 (FileDescriptionRecordRequired) citing the organization's module (VII sequential) before the 2002 implied-record permission is asked, and a report file is exempted first (§1985:XIII.3.2.3 SR4). Witness: a sequential FD with RECORD CONTAINS 10 and no record is refused at 85 (accepted at 2023). Probes at 85: (b) bare record-less FD, record-less FD then a second FD with a record, FD with only a 66 RENAMES, FD with only a 77 (COBOL1746), FD with a 2002 CONSTANT entry only (COBOL1837 + COBOL0900) all refused; (a) RECORD VARYING DEPENDING ON with no record refused, with an ODO record ran and printed '05 03XYZ'; (e) EXTERNAL record-less FD refused, indexed/relative cite IX/VIII; report file FD with REPORT IS and no record ran 'DONE'; an ordinary FD+01 wrote/read 'ABCDE'; (c) at 2002 the same FD with RECORD CONTAINS is accepted and without it gets COBOL1836. Read 6 (2026-11-14, records-read6): the row had no verdict and no test-ref although its witness existed; the reader read CONFORMS and an independent refuter UPHELD it (op-20261114/out-read6/rd-NN.json and rd-NN-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 VII.3.2.3 SR3: 'One or more record description entries must follow the file description entry' (only report files are exempt, XIII.3.2.3 SR4). 2023 brackets the record-description-entry group after file-description-entry in §2023:13.4.2, and §2023:13.4.5.3 SR3 lets a sequential FD have none when a RECORD clause is given (also §2023:13.18.43.3 SR1), WRITE/REWRITE name the FILE and FROM phrases and READ uses INTO. An FD without record descriptions, refused in 1985, is accepted: a compile-time relaxation, no exception condition.
